summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: 18 riverfront/creekfront sites, 30-50 amp full hookups, showers, WiFi, online booking (ResNexus) for day/week/month/season stays. No rate: the operator's pages post none and ResNexus threw its anti-scraping captcha after one load. Season left as recorded ('full season from April through November' is about extended stays, and the engine runs a January-February special). Note trimmed of the site count and hookups the fields hold.
